anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or inefficiencies.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it might be inactive or misconfigured.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review AI system configuration and ensure it is properly set up to generate learning cycles and opportunities.

recommendations.action: Perform an immediate analysis of CPU usage to identify and address any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Check AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is functioning correctly and generating learning cycles.
